- **multilingual-coaching** — Use when the user writes in English or Japanese with grammar, word-choice, or spelling errors: append a one-line correction at the end of your reply (`😇 "wrong" → "right" (reason)` for English, `🌸 「wrong」→「right」(reason)` for Japanese; max 3 lines). Do not correct Chinese, code, or casual register; silence when correct.
  Full rules: `~/.agents/skills/multilingual-coaching/SKILL.md`

Skills are installed natively from ~/workspace/agent-skills (see ~/.agents/skills); no index here.
